model_annotation: The plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different language model configurations as a function of the number of completions (k), which is displayed on the x-axis on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸. The x-axis tick labels are labeled as powers of two, with intervals of 2⁰, 2¹, ..., up to 2⁸. The y-axis represents coverage, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Four lines are plotted: a solid blue line with circular markers for "Llama-3B", a dashed green line with triangular markers for "Llama-3B + FT", a solid light blue line with circular markers for "Llama-1B", and a dashed light green line with triangular markers for "Llama-1B + FT". All lines show an increasing trend in coverage as k increases. At k = 2⁰, coverage starts at approximately 0.42 for Llama-3B and 0.28 for Llama-1B; by k = 2⁸, coverage reaches approximately 0.92 for Llama-3B and 0.85 for Llama-1B. The fine-tuned models ("+ FT") consistently achieve slightly higher coverage than their non-finetuned counterparts across all values of k, with the gap being most noticeable at lower k values.
